semantic_review.reason: The starting record explicitly contains the counterpressure and the current record contains the safeguards it caused. A not-observed status conflicts with that source, and not-observed is also contractually incompatible with citing role evidence.

root_cause.token_failure: Medium Gemini reasoning consumed nearly the entire shared completion budget before the tiny JSON answer completed.
root_cause.semantic_failure: The current status enum still asks the model to compress historical observation and later integration into one label, allowing not_observed and resolved to be confused.
root_cause.not_a_schema_support_failure: The same endpoint and strict schema succeeded on prior split tasks.

decision.next_design: Ask the model separately whether the mechanism was observed and whether it was later integrated, then derive resolved/unresolved/not_observed in code. Use low reasoning effort for this small structured task and preserve the same separate assistant-coverage call.
